newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 7.

text.p: - The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:

* Israeli and Palestinian leaders began negotiations to try to maintain peace following recent clashes in the West Bank and Gaza. They concentrated on handing over control of most of Hebron to the Palestinians.
* Afghanistan's professionals and other middle class people flee Kabul as Taleban militia impose Muslim fundamentalist decrees on the city.
